data.narrative:
Strand Therapeutics is a Series B-stage biotech company in the Biotech & Health sector with $205M raised to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 8 private peers (including Colossal Biosciences at $10.3B, Chai Discovery at $3.8B, New Limit at $3.1B, and Eikon Therapeutics at $539M) and 3 public sector peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier to the $205M raised proxy, implying a valuation of $390M. Peer-median anchoring across the four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $3.5B, with a range from $539M to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales is not applicable given Strand's private status and undisclosed revenue. 

The two applicable methods produce a wide implied range. The triangulated midpoint across both methods stands at $1.9B, with a low-end anchor of $331M (conservative stage-progression floor) and a high-end ceiling of $4.0B (peer median plus 15% buffer). Key uncertainties include the significant dispersion within the peer set—a 19x range from Eikon to Colossal—and the stage heterogeneity of the comp universe, which includes three Series C peers. A Series B valuation in the $800M to $2.0B range appears most defensible given stage and capital deployment to date.
